_README: Settings of the Telegram notifier (bitpin/notify.py, service bitpin-bot-notify, Persian guide docs/TELEGRAM_FA.md). On the server this file is /etc/bitpin-bot/notify.json (0640 root:bitpin). Keys starting with '_' are comments; unknown keys are rejected (typo protection). Values shown are the built-in defaults, so an empty {} works too. SECRETS NEVER GO IN THIS FILE: the bot token, the chat id(s), the Telegram proxy and the optional Kimi key are read ONLY from the environment (/etc/bitpin-bot/notify.env: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, TELEGRAM_HTTPS_PROXY, KIMI_API_KEY, KIMI_HTTPS_PROXY); any key named like token/secret/api_key/password is refused. The notifier only READS the trading bot's state directory and never trades or calls Bitpin.
_state_dir: The TRADING bot's state directory, read-only for the notifier (kimi_decisions.jsonl, kimi_runner.jsonl, <mode>_trades.csv, live_orders.json, runner/risk state, kimi_equity.json, news_cache.json, the STOP file ...). Only an allowlist of file names is ever opened: bitpin_token.json, account.json and the like are never read. For the paper service use /var/lib/bitpin-bot-paper with mode "paper".
_notify_state_dir: The notifier's OWN state (cursors, outbox of unsent messages, sent-event ids, command offset, translation cache, the /stop request). The only directory it writes. Must differ from state_dir.
_mode: "live" or "paper": which of the bot's files to read (live_trades.csv / runner_state_live.json / risk_state_live.json / bot_live.log, or the paper_* ones). Records of the other mode are ignored.
_poll_seconds: How often the state files are checked (2..300 s). It is also the long-poll time of the command check, so a /status is answered within about this long.
_commands_enabled: false = no commands at all (the notifier then never calls getUpdates); messages are still sent. Commands are accepted only in a PRIVATE chat with the bot from a TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (never in a group: every member could send them). A command sent while the notifier was not running, or one that reached it more than 10 minutes after it was sent (Telegram / proxy outage), is NOT executed and gets a reply saying so: a /stop from hours ago never stops the bot by surprise. If reading commands fails with HTTP 409 (another program / a webhook uses the token) or 401 for 10 minutes, an alert says that commands, /stop too, do not work.
_allow_stop_command: Opt-in emergency stop from Telegram: /stop, then /stop_confirm within stop_confirm_seconds. It needs the two relay units bitpin-bot-notify-stop.path/.service (docs/TELEGRAM_FA.md); without them /stop replies that the bot was NOT stopped and names the server command. false = /stop is refused. There is never a /resume: resuming needs the server.
_stop_confirm_seconds: Time allowed between /stop and /stop_confirm from the SAME chat (10..600 s), measured between the two messages' Telegram times (a busy notifier never makes a confirmation sent in time too late).
_stop_verify_seconds: After /stop_confirm the notifier waits this long for /var/lib/bitpin-bot/STOP to appear and then reports success or failure honestly (5..600 s). An unprocessed request is deleted when this runs out.
_stop_request_max_age_seconds: The relay (notify_bot.py apply-stop) ignores a stop request older than this (30..3600 s), measured from the Telegram time of your /stop_confirm message, so a request left behind never stops the bot by surprise later.
_backfill_decisions: First start only: also send the last N decisions from the history (0..50). 0 = no history, just a short 'notifier started' message with the current status.
_replay_max_age_hours: When a watched file was truncated or replaced (rotation, restore), it is read again from its start, but events older than this are NOT re-sent (0..720 h). Events older than max(1 h, this) are not sent one by one but summarised in ONE catch-up message (numbers of decisions and trades): after the notifier itself was off, and for queued messages that could not be delivered that long (Telegram / proxy outage while it ran).
_restart_message_min_hours: A (silent) 'notifier restarted' message is sent at most once per this many hours (0..720), so a restart loop cannot flood the chat.
_cycle_minutes: Length of the trading bot's cycle for the heartbeat. null = automatic: taken from the bot's own records (cycle_min, e.g. 30 with brain_cycle_minutes 30), 60 before the bot has written one. Set a number (1..1440) only to override it.
_heartbeat_factor: Heartbeat alert when the bot has written nothing (log, runner state, runner records) for longer than heartbeat_factor x cycle_minutes (1.2..20): the bot probably stopped. A recovery message follows when it writes again. The alert names the STOP file / a drawdown halt when that is the reason.
_kimi_down_alert_minutes: Alert when Kimi has given no valid decision for longer than this (kimi_brain_state.json invalid_since; 10..10080 min; null = no alert). Recovery message on the next valid decision.
_news_down_alert_minutes: Alert when the news research has been failing for longer than this, counted from its FIRST failed attempt after the last good brief (news_cache.json error_since; 10..10080 min; null = no alert). With the daily brief research runs only before a decision, so the alert is repeated only after a NEW failed attempt. Recovery message when a brief is fetched again.
_unknown_order_alert_minutes: Live mode: alert for an order of unknown outcome in live_orders.json older than this (0..1440 min), and a message when it is resolved. A second alert (with how to check the bot's log, and the resolve-order steps to use ONLY if the bot says it needs you) only by the bot's own limits: 10 failed lookups in a row, or still unknown after 20 min (the bot itself settles a never-seen order after 15 min).
_alert_repeat_minutes: An alert that stays true (bot inactive, Kimi down, news down, bot files unreadable) and repeated cycle warnings are sent again at most this often (0..10080 min; 0 = only once). While the bot is stopped on purpose (STOP / drawdown halt) or not running, the Kimi / news alerts are not repeated (their state is frozen). The same bot fallback repeated every cycle during a Kimi outage (cash sweep / derisk with the same targets) rings once, repeats are sent silently with '(repeat n)', and a reminder rings after this long.
_fill_group_wait_seconds: Fills are grouped per cycle using the cycle's kimi_runner.jsonl record (one message per cycle, linked to its decision). Fills in the trades CSV that no cycle record claims are sent as their own group (e.g. an order resolved later) once a LATER cycle record was read and this time has passed (10..3600 s), or after max(this, 2 cycles) without any record: a slow cycle (Bitpin retries) writes its record only after its last order, and its fills stay one message.
_daily_summary_time: Daily summary at this Tehran time ("HH:MM"; null = none). It covers the time since the PREVIOUS summary (24 h; so the cycle that trades right after this time is in the next summary, never in none): equity, P&L since the start (kimi_equity.json), change in the window, the 'hold USDT' benchmark (USDT_IRT price of the FIRST decision record = the bot's start, with its date, vs now), trades and fees, decisions, Kimi token usage (kimi_budget.json + news_budget.json, UTC day) and health.
_max_reasoning_chars: Longest reasoning / Persian explanation shown in a decision message (200..3500 characters); /last shows more. Messages longer than Telegram's 4096 characters are split.
_min_change_points: A target weight change smaller than this many percentage points is shown as 'no change' and not listed under buy / sell (0..20).
_max_outbox: Most unsent messages kept while Telegram is unreachable (20..5000); beyond it the oldest ordinary messages are folded into the catch-up digest (counted there and in notify_bot.py status), never dropped silently. Alerts, recoveries, /stop replies and daily summaries are never folded. A message delivered more than 15 min after it was queued is marked late and, unless it is an alert, sent without a sound.
_coin_names_fa: Extra or changed Persian coin names, e.g. {"TON": "تون‌کوین"}. Built in: BTC, ETH, USDT, XRP, SOL, DOGE, PAXG, DASH, SHIB, PEPE, ADA, TRX, BNB, SUI, LINK, NEAR, ARB and more.

telegram._section: Telegram Bot API client. Always through TELEGRAM_HTTPS_PROXY from notify.env (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1081); http_proxy / https_proxy / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY are never used. https only, redirects never followed.
telegram._api_base: Bot API endpoint (https only). Leave as is.
telegram._timeout_seconds: Hard wall-clock limit of one request (3..120 s); the command long poll adds poll_seconds.
telegram._max_retries: Retries of one send after a network error, HTTP 429 (waiting Telegram's retry_after) or 5xx, with exponential backoff (0..10). HTTP 400/401/403/404 are never retried. After the retries the message stays queued and is sent later.
telegram._backoff_seconds: First retry wait; doubles each retry (0.1..60 s).
telegram._backoff_max_seconds: Longest single retry wait (a longer retry_after keeps the message queued instead of blocking).
telegram._min_send_interval_seconds: Pause between two messages to the same chat (Telegram allows about one per second).
telegram._silent_kinds: Message kinds sent without a notification sound: started, summary, recovery, hold (a Kimi decision to keep the portfolio: up to 48 a day at 30-min cycles), decision (a rebalance), invalid, fallback, trades, info, warning, digest (the catch-up message), alert, stop. Remove "hold" to hear HOLD decisions too. Late messages (queued more than 15 min) are silent anyway unless they are alerts.

translation._section: OPTIONAL Persian translation of Kimi's English reasoning / news / risks. Order of preference: (1) a Persian field in the decision record (report_fa) - no call; (2) this translation via Kimi, only when KIMI_API_KEY is set in notify.env (proxy: KIMI_HTTPS_PROXY), cached per decision; (3) otherwise the English text. The translation is display text only (at most one per check, so it never delays other messages longer than timeout_seconds). The text to translate comes partly from web search: a reply that brings numbers or Latin words (tickers, names, commands) that are not in the English source, or whose length is out of proportion, is rejected and the English text is shown; links, @names and /commands in it are never clickable.
translation._enabled: false = never call Kimi for translations (report_fa is still used).
translation._base_url: OpenAI-compatible Moonshot endpoint (https only; must match the key's platform).
translation._timeout_seconds: Hard limit of one translation incl. one retry (5..300 s); on timeout the English text is sent.
translation._max_tokens: Completion token limit (256..65536). kimi-k2.6 reasons before answering: small values give empty replies.
translation._temperature: null = not sent (recommended); a number 0..2 is sent as is.
translation._max_calls_per_day: Translation calls per UTC day (0..1000; 0 = off). HOLD decisions may use at most half of them, so the rebalances later in the day are still translated. Counted in notify_translations.json in notify_state_dir.
translation._max_tokens_per_day: Translation tokens per UTC day (0..100000000). This is on top of the trading bot's own Kimi budget.
translation._failure_pause_minutes: After a failed translation no new one is tried for this long (0..1440 min), so a down proxy does not delay every decision message.
